sidebar.securityText: Your journal is AES-256 encrypted. Even the PeaceFlow team can't read it. You can delete everything at any time.

prompts: What made you feel like you tried hard enough today?
Is there a feeling that's been staying with you for a long time today?
If you had to name today's energy in one sentence, what would it be?
What's making you feel a little lighter than yesterday?
Is there anything you want to forgive yourself for today?
What's one small but memorable moment from today?
If you wake up feeling lighter tomorrow, what do you think will have changed?
Do you really need rest, help, or more clarity right now?
